ModMetaData.name: No Metabolism Limit
ModMetaData.author: Allvoid
ModMetaData.description:
Removes the -5/+5 metabolism cap from genes (Biotech DLC).
Mod settings: - Optionally keep hunger scaling past the cap, instead of vanilla flattening it at x225%. Each further point below -5 adds hunger, and positive metabolism can be extended all the way down to 0% hunger. - Randomly generated genepacks stay inside the vanilla range by default, so only what you build yourself is affected. - The complexity limit is left alone by default; it can be removed separately.
Gene and genepack cards keep showing their real metabolism value and hunger rate.
